body:
Welcome to CreateMore SMP! ⚙️
Looking for the ultimate place to engineer, automate, and build without limits? CreateMore SMP is a high-performance, industrial-focused server designed to bring the best out of the Create Mod and its most powerful addons. Whether you are a master of kinetics or just starting your first windmill, there is a place for you here.

🌍 Accessible to Everyone
We believe that Minecraft should be for everyone. That’s why our server is fully accessible to all players, including those using:

Official Minecraft Launcher

TLauncher

Prism, CurseForge, or MultiMC

If you have the modpack and a love for building, you are welcome on our server!

🛡️ A Safe & Secure Experience
We take your safety and your builds seriously. You don’t have to worry about your hard work disappearing overnight.

Safe Environment: We have active moderation and security measures in place to prevent griefing and toxicity.

Stable Hosting: Our dedicated hardware ensures that your massive factories won't cause the server to crawl.

Community Trust: Join a growing group of players who value collaboration over destruction.

🚀 What Makes Us Different?
Built as an optimized fork of Just Create SMP 2, we’ve added the features players actually wanted:

TFMG (The Factory Must Grow): Adds heavy industry, oil refining, and advanced metallurgy.

Enhanced Optimization: Custom-tuned for high FPS and low server TPS lag.

QoL Additions: Small tweaks that make inventory management and building much smoother.

💬 Join the Hub
Ready to start your industrial revolution? Join our Discord to get the IP, download the modpack, and meet the community!

Official Discord: https://discord.gg/qns3PZ96FG

Grab your wrench—it’s time to build.
